summary: We decided to take on the challenge of designing an interactive space mission game on Roblox, one of the most popular gaming platforms among younger generations. Our project allows players to experience the process of planning, building, and controlling a space mission from scratch. Players must select components, manage their budget and spacecraft mass, and make important decisions throughout the mission. During gameplay, unexpected events and technical challenges may arise, requiring players to analyze situations and respond accordingly. By incorporating real scientific data from NASA and orbital simulations using GMAT, we aim to make the experience as realistic and educational as possible. Our game also includes a space museum and testing and control rooms, where players can explore past missions and learn about space technology. Ultimately, our goal is to inspire younger generations to become interested in science, engineering, and space exploration through an engaging, accessible, and interactive learning experience.
details:
Our Roblox game is designed to introduce players to the process of developing and managing a real space mission. Players can build their own spacecraft, select components, manage resources, test their designs, and respond to unexpected events throughout the mission.

Our main goal is to make complex scientific concepts more accessible and engaging, especially for younger generations. The game includes a space museum where players can explore historical missions, as well as testing and control rooms to understand how spacecraft are prepared and operated. It also introduces concepts such as spacecraft mass, budgets, fuel consumption, and orbital mechanics.

To develop our project, we mainly used Claude as a coding assistant, Visual Studio Code, Python, and Lua, Roblox's programming language. We also incorporated real NASA data and used GMAT (General Mission Analysis Tool) to support realistic orbital calculations and mission parameters. The game was developed using Roblox Studio.

What makes our project unique is the combination of scientific accuracy and interactive gameplay. By using a platform familiar to younger audiences, we transform complex engineering concepts into an entertaining learning experience.

Throughout development, we focused on accessibility, scientific accuracy, creativity, and problem-solving. We also wanted players to understand that trial and error is an essential part of scientific discovery.

Ultimately, our goal is to inspire curiosity, critical thinking, and interest in STEM fields while allowing players to experience the challenges and excitement of space exploration.
